notes.title: Sky Mercenaries 1.0.4 is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
A new version of Sky Mercenaries is now live on Steam!

From the Polarity Flow Studios:
"This is a new version with new features, improvements and fixes. 
There was a remaining issue with different controller types. We re-created
the way how inputs work in Sky Mercenaries, this should fix all controller
related problems and guarantee support for all different types.
We optimized the collision system, all sound FX and more."

Here is the full list of changes in version 1.0.4:

- optimized controls
- new collision system
- achievement unlock refresh
- optimized sound effects
- new show controls option
- additional controller support
- new 2 player pilot skills combos
- 2 player coop dual pad support
- 2 player coop dual joystick support
- new gamepad haptic feedbacks
- difficulty balancing
- analog flight-stick fix
- optimized shadows
- bonus boss control reset fix
- stage 1-3 background rotation fix
- 2 player coop haptics fix
- repair 2 upgrade fix

notes.title: Sky Mercenaries now live on Steam
notes.content:
An epic sky battle awaits you! Choose your pilot and fighter to join the ultimate 2D S.H.M.U.P action ! Fight over 50 enemy types on 8 worlds in over 32 story missions and unlimited random content. To be prepared for the overpowering enemy fleet and challenging boss fights. Upgrade and skill fighters, drones and pilots the way you like to play them. Get powerful and permanent, visible upgrades, armor and different types of weapons. Level up your pilots and assign skill points in 3 different skill trees to unlock a variety of abilities like auto-shield, critical buffs and more. Join the Mercenaries now!

Game features:
• hand drawn full speed action
• 8 worlds, 32 missions and bonus stages
• 3 upgradeable wing fighters with a tripple part damage model
• day & night Missions, unique light engine
• 3 pilots with different skill-trees, various combinations
• tons of permanent upgrades and stage power ups
• 5 balanced difficulty levels
• command up to 8 drones, 6 different drone types
• over 50 different reacting enemy types
• damage system, critical hits and amor ratings
• 2 upgradeable main firemodes - red / blue system
• 15 different upgradeable weapons
• 16 epic bossfights
• unlockable random stage generator
• full mouse, gamepad, joystick or keyboard support
• 3 different INGame shops for INGame credits
• screen bombs, overload system
• multi language support eng, sp, fr, de
• resolution auto-scale and inFight zoom
